<LOCKED_0001>
Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme contained in <MATH_0002>.
Let <MATH_0003> and <MATH_0004>
be <MATH_0005>-morphisms of categories fibred in groupoids over <MATH_0006>.
If <MATH_0007> is representable by algebraic spaces
and <MATH_0008> is a stack in groupoids, then
<MATH_0009> is a stack in groupoids.

The property of a morphism being representable by algebraic spaces
is preserved under base-change
(Lemma <REF_0001>),
and so, passing to the base-change
<MATH_0001> over <MATH_0002>,
we may reduce to the case of a morphism of categories
fibred in groupoids <MATH_0003>
which is representable by algebraic spaces, and
whose target is a stack in groupoids; our goal is then to prove
that <MATH_0004> is also a stack in groupoids.
This follows from Stacks, Lemma
<REF_0002>
whose assumptions are satisfied as a result of
Lemma <REF_0003>.
